info.prompt: Neon cyan arteries snake across obsidian tiles, connecting pulsating nodes of electric magenta where dice hover like frozen specimens in a lab, their crystalline facets refracting the glow of gothic circuit-filigree overhead—the player's shadow stretches unnaturally long as 40Hz vibrations warp the air, terminal overlays flashing "CRITICAL FAILURE" in staggered glyphs, the camera pulling back to reveal the entire table is a living, breathing organ of some vast bio-mechanical entity.
